name: Kobayashi Ran
source:
Likes: [url=/c21415]Azusa[/url] and rice cakes covered in bean jam
Dislikes: Bell peppers
Hobbies: Observing Azusa

A student of St. Cruz Girls' High School class 2-3. She's in love with her childhood friend and classmate, Azusa, and calls herself "Azusa's wife." She talks like a boy and appears to have a childish personality. She wound up in Heavenly Host Elementary School after performing the Sachiko Ever After charm with Azusa.
